data.body: Implementation complete: extracted _locked_commit_phase in _store/push.py (shared by commit_and_push_tickets_branch, behavior unchanged) and exported commit_tickets_branch(tracker, message=, paths=, strict=, author_*) — pathspec-capable, commit-only, NO push. _commit_binding_store_snapshot now routes through the locked seam with paths=<the 5 existing state files>, strict=True feeding the existing False+stderr+bridge_alerts fail-open handler; raw-git-ok marker removed. Per-file idempotency (bug 1e08) now comes from the seam's pathspec-scoped 'status --porcelain -z' — only reported-dirty paths are staged (git add fails hard on unmatched pathspecs), anchored with :(top) magic because porcelain paths are toplevel-relative while add pathspecs are cwd-relative (found via the integration fixture where the tracker is a subdir of a larger repo). New pin: tests/unit/test_commit_tickets_branch_pathspec_11a9.py (5 tests). Updated 5 tests that pinned the old git_adapter add/diff/commit composition to drive real tracker repos / the new seam. Suites: 3082 reconciler + 103 push tests pass; make lint, typecheck, complexity ratchet (new=0 increased=0) green.
